newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index end up after polls, gains ease.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index end up after polls, gains ease.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended higher on Monday, but profit-taking near the close eased strong gains posted earlier in the day, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 3.70 points, or 0.53 percent, to 699.73 points after touching a high of 701.75 points. Advancers led decliners by 78 to 47 with 62 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at around 685 billion rupiah against about 861 billion rupiah on Friday.
"Players took profit after the index briefly hovered above the psychological level of 700 points," one broker said.
